### EL Breakout

Led by @danceratopz 

- **Bogota Devnet 3 Scoping**
  - Ref: ethpandaops devnet spec pages: [bogota-devnet-3 (proposal, not final)](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/bogota-devnet-3) (ref: [bogota-devnet-2](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/bogota-devnet-2)).
  - **Frames design choices**: how does [EIP-8141](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8141) carry PQ signatures / claims? `bogota-devnet-3` target is leanSPHINCS without aggregation, forward-compatible with [EIP-8288](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8288) aggregation.
    - Decision space overview (10 dimensions, side-by-side table) from @gurukamath: ethereum/execution-specs#4069.
    - The three candidates, short walkthrough from each author:
      1. **Claims list**, kevaundray/EIPs#7 @kevaundray
         - Top-level `tx.claims` replaces `tx.signatures`; verifiers identified by address (3 reserved claim-only protocol verifiers, plus permissionless pure contracts / precompiles).
         - Witnesses segregated from day 1, carried beside the block (`dependency_proof`); accounts check `HASCLAIM(verifier, key, msg)`.
      2. **`PROOF` frame**, ethereum/EIPs#12714 @lightclient
         - Leading `PROOF` frames (`key || msg || proof`) replace `tx.signatures`; the verifier is the frame target, run in a pure context; 3 new callable verifier precompiles.
         - Proofs stay inline for now, stripping left to a later EIP; accounts read claims with `PROOFPARAM`.
      3. **EIP-8504**, ethereum/EIPs#12672 @ilitteri
         - Separate EIP on top of 8141: a non-executing proof frame declares `(scheme, data_hash, verification_key_hash)` triples; leanSPHINCS only, secp256k1 / P-256 stay on the signature list.
         - Scheme byte, no custom verifiers; witnesses segregated now, in the block body. Implemented in ethrex, EELS branch with tests exists.
    - Measurements: the candidates implemented in ethrex (+ ethlambda), with and without builder-side aggregation, from @ilitteri: [experimental comparison](https://ethresear.ch/t/paths-to-post-quantum-execution-in-hegota-an-experimental-comparison/26304). Also measures a fourth design, an extended signature list based on this [note](https://hackmd.io/@Nerolation/BJEQraRAGe) (no EIP PR).
    - Heads up: hybrid variant kevaundray/EIPs#9 (metadata-only `PROOF` frames + segregated witnesses + `HASCLAIM`); leanPCS support sketched in kevaundray/EIPs#10.
    - Which design is the `bogota-devnet-3` target? If not all of it, can we settle the sub-decisions?
      - Claim container: list or frame?
      - Verifier identity: address or scheme byte?
      - Witness segregation: in 8141 now, or a later EIP?
      - Transaction identity: must the tx hash survive proof stripping / aggregation?
      - Witness pricing: gas per byte, or a separate block-level witness byte budget?
    - Client round: preference and implementation cost.
  - Keep or extend `bogota-devnet-2` scope? Candidate EIPs
    - [EIP-8360](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8360): TCREATE opcode
      - [`spec@eda18b9e`](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/eda18b9ef39f467079e2ad31aea34ee9242266fd/EIPS/eip-8360.md), ethereum/execution-specs#3888, see also the [comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2320#issuecomment-7194367808) from @milonite below.
    - [EIP-7668](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7668): Remove bloom filters
      - [`spec@bdf8cfbe`](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/bdf8cfbedcba5162c93328f16bb0681227d7c366/EIPS/eip-7668.md), ethereum/execution-specs#3719
    - [EIP-3298](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3298): Remove storage-clear refund and refund cap
      - [`spec@6dac5e74`](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/6dac5e74918b54511298fdbff79650e8f8d27d78/EIPS/eip-3298.md), ethereum/execution-specs#3733
    - Heads up: [EIP-8298](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8298) `SETCODEFROM` is already in `bogota-devnet-2`, but ethereum/EIPs#12716 (@CPerezz, draft) changes it in a breaking way: deferred code change, adopt only from own code. Overview from @jochem-brouwer. In for `bogota-devnet-3`?
